In Islamic tradition, the name Ilyas is associated with the Prophet Elijah, who was a righteous and pious individual. The name Jivan conveys a sense of spirituality, piety, and righteousness. In Arabic, the name is also associated with the word جِن (Jin), meaning 'spirit' or 'angel.' The name Jivan is also found in Persian and Urdu cultures, where it is written as جِوان (Jivan), meaning 'living' or 'spirited.' In modern times, the name Jivan has gained popularity in various Muslim cultures, including Indian and Pakistani communities.
